name: GR-3
summary: Fourier's turn back toward the care market it came from. GR-3 trades the bare industrial look for a soft-touch shell in automotive-grade upholstery and carries 31 distributed pressure sensors, so being touched — and touching a person — is part of the design rather than a hazard. It is pitched at eldercare and companionship rather than factory work.
notable: Care-focused humanoid with a soft upholstered shell
31 distributed pressure sensors for whole-body touch
